Senior Backend Software Engineer

Company: TechCorp Inc.
Location: San Francisco, CA (Remote OK)

About the Role:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to join our platform team. You will design and build scalable microservices, work closely with our data team, and mentor junior engineers.

Requirements:
- Must have 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Required: Strong proficiency in Python
- Required: Strong proficiency in Java
- Required: Experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases
- Required: Experience building and deploying microservices
- Required: Experience with AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda)
- Must have experience with RESTful API design
- Required: Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes
- Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
- Must have experience with CI/CD pipelines

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
- Familiarity with GraphQL
- Experience with monitoring tools (Datadog, Prometheus)
- Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform)
- Contributions to open-source projects are a plus
